technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with supertrend flip-up and volume spike present reversal potential, but lack of bullish momentum confirmation, negative CMF, and price below all major moving averages create significant downside risk.

fundamental.summary: MMM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 22 days creating elevated event risk.

sentiment.summary: Mixed signals: Congressional activity is neutral with one small purchase offset by two larger sales; market fear (32 score) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but lack of recent news sentiment and weak congressional conviction limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (93.4) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinational earnings, and earnings event in 22 days adds binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold RSI (9), supertrend flip-up, and 15x volume spike create textbook reversal setup with price near support (72.45) in fear-driven market offering contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price below all major moving averages, negative CMF distribution, MACD bearish, no momentum confirmation, VIX crisis levels (93.4), inverted yield curve recession signal, and earnings binary event in 22 days create overwhelming downside risk that overshadows technical reversal signals.
